10033.d: Esiplaanil roigastara, mille mulgu kohal mees aeruga õlal. Vasemal, diagonaalis pildi keskääreni ulatuv jõgi, mis keskalal ühineb suurema, järvetaolise veekoguga. Jõe kõrgemal tagakaldal lehtpuid ja torniga kivihoone. Sellest paremal, madalikul, gooti stiilis kirik. Paremal järve kaldal puude vahel rida taluhooneid. Kauguses paistab teise kiriku torni siluett. Järve pinnaleespool sõudepaat kolme sõitjaga, kaugemal purjekaid. Öises taevas täiskuu.
10033.de: In the foreground, a pole fence with a man carrying an oar over his shoulder above a gap in it. On the left, a river running diagonally to the middle edge of the picture, which in the middle area joins a larger, lake-like body of water. On the higher far bank of the river, deciduous trees and a stone building with a tower. To the right of it, on lower ground, a Gothic-style church. On the right, along the lake shore, a row of farm buildings among trees. In the distance, the silhouette of another church tower is visible. On the surface of the lake, a rowing boat with three passengers, and sailing boats further away. A full moon in the night sky.
